I gave Claude Fable 5.1 eight hours to research, code and backtest trading strategies from scratch.

No existing trading bot. No indicator recipe. No strategy for Claude to copy.

Could it move beyond writing code and discover a trading strategy worth taking further?

In this step-by-step video, I connect Claude to TradingKit / TraderDEV’s backtesting tools, give it my research instructions and let it work through an eight-hour strategy-development challenge.

TradingKit handles the backtesting without requiring Claude to control my TradingView account. Once the research is finished, I take one of Claude’s strategies into TradingView to inspect the code, trading rules and historical results.

By the end of the run, the dashboard reports 113 strategies, more than 410 backtests and 14 candidates flagged as profitable on historical data.

But finding an attractive backtest is only the beginning.

You’ll see the dashboard, the strategy Claude selected, its MACD-based trading logic, the drawdown behind the returns, and how the results compare with buying and holding the same market.

In this video, you’ll discover:

title: 3Blue1Brown Asked Jane Street How Quants See Time Differently
description:
Build your first live trading algorithm 👉https://cryptomomentumgroup.com/

A Jane Street researcher told 3Blue1Brown that time in markets is continuous, and we just sample the points we care about. Trades arrive whenever they arrive, so your 1 minute or daily bars are a grid laid over the data afterwards. Even the waiting time between trades carries information, and good systematic models account for that.
